sentence_stem: Never before in the company's history
correct_completion: had the board approved such a bold investment.
full_sentence: Never before in the company's history had the board approved such a bold investment.
acceptable_variants: had the board been so willing to take risks.
had such a bold investment been approved.

options.text: the board approved such a bold investment.
options.why_wrong: After a negative adverb such as 'never before', English requires subject-auxiliary inversion, so 'had the board' is needed here.

options.text: had the board approved such a bold investment.
the board has approved a bold investment.
options.why_wrong: The present perfect does not fit the 'never before' structure, which requires inverted past perfect in this position.

options.text: so the board will approve the investment.
options.why_wrong: This introduces a future result with 'so', which does not complete the fronted negative phrase.

explanation: When a negative adverbial such as 'never before' opens the sentence, English places the auxiliary before the subject. The completion must therefore use inverted word order with the past perfect.
translation: Nunca antes na história da empresa o conselho havia aprovado um investimento tão ousado.
